spanish: y cinco travesaños a las tablas del costado del mishkán el segundo, y cinco travesaños a las tablas del mishkán a los extremos, mar.

findings.issue: Common noun left untranslated as mishkán; common nouns stay Spanish.
Feminine ordinal modifies the side, not the masculine tabernacle; masculine el segundo after mishkán reads as a second tabernacle.
Directional suffix on the sea noun is dropped; comma-detached mar does not mark the extremities as toward the sea.

notes: Five, bars, boards, side, both conjunctions, and the second preposition match.
